about: Q-BH0 (fix/pine-v6-bool-history-false, NUMBER PENDING): a Pine v6 bool's written history `x[k]` reads `false` on the first k bars, where it reaches before history begins (TradingView's captures vw-v6-bool-history-bar0-{spy,rddt}-1d-2026-11-19), and the read itself after; v5 and older keep `na`, judged per token, so a v5 library inside a v6 script keeps it; a number's history keeps `na`; only those bars are answered, never a bool held as `na` after them. The columnar lane (pine.js::v6BoolHistory, both reads of the Resolver's offset arm) and every arm of the run's offset lowering (pineRuntimeFrontend.js::v6BoolHistoryIr: a slot, a function's own slot, an expression hoisted into a committed series, a request's own region, a column the run reads). Every wrap, gate and reading, broken once, must turn its rail red.
